close_reason: Introduced BodyFetchArgs struct; both call sites updated
description: email.rs: apply_body_value_args takes fetch_text_body_values, fetch_html_body_values, fetch_all_body_values, max_body_value_bytes, and body_prop_set as five separate parameters. Two call sites must count positional booleans; a wrong-order transposition is a silent bug. Suggested rewrite: introduce a small BodyFetchArgs struct { fetch_text: bool, fetch_html: bool, fetch_all: bool, max_bytes: u64 } built once per handler invocation, and pass &body_prop_set separately. The call sites then read apply_body_value_args(&mut val, &fetch_args, &body_prop_set) with field-named construction instead of five positional literals.
title: apply_body_value_args: 6-bool positional args hide call-site meaning
